title: Depotentiation of emotional reactivity using TMR during REM sleep
description: This dataset comprises fMRI, EEG, ECG, and behavioural data from a study examining how Targeted Memory Reactivation (TMR) during REM sleep affects emotional reactivity to affective images. Participants rated arousal of affective image-sound pairs, with a subset of sounds cued during subsequent REM sleep, and their responses were assessed via heart rate deceleration, fMRI scanning, and follow-up ratings over multiple sessions. The study aims to elucidate mechanisms underlying memory-based depotentiation of emotional reactivity.
methods_description: fMRI data were acquired using a Siemens Magnetom Prisma 3T scanner with a 32-channel head coil. Heart rate was recorded using BrainVision BrainAmp ExG with an ExG AUX box and multitrodes during behavioural sessions and via pulse oximetry during fMRI sessions. Polysomnography included ten electrodes: 6 EEG channels (F3, F4, C3, C4, O1, O2), 2 EMG channels, and 2 EOG channels, referenced to the average of left and right mastoids. fMRI data were preprocessed using fMRIPrep 20.2.7, and T1-weighted structural scans were defaced using pydeface version 2.0.2.
